name: Maii
sweep_summary: Maii (maii1238) is not in the catalog. The only title-keyword hit, Auer 1989 'Some ways to count morae', is a Glottolog false positive: Glottolog attached it to Maii [mmm] by automatic assignment from the word 'morae' (Maii alt. name Mae-Morae). I fetched sources the author's open FreiDok offprint, logged) and read the text: it is about German dialects (OHG, Bavarian, Alemannic) and Germanic/Latin/Greek mora counting, with no mention of Maii or any Oceanic language. Relevance: other-language-or-variety; priority none. No first-hand statement of Maii word stress was found in this sweep; Glottolog lists only Tryon 1976 (wordlist) and Tryon 1996 for the language, and the Wikipedia page carries no phonology.

earlier_scan.note: Vanuatu; Glottolog shows only Tryon 1996 subclassification comment and endangerment sources; no description found
